Chapter 1062: 12 A Promise (Request For Monthly Tickets)_2

Chapter 1062: Chapter 12 A Promise (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2

The Eye of Myriad Laws paused for a moment, then continued observing.

The second jade slip… was for the Chaos Realm evolution branch.

The third jade slip… was for the Chaos Realm evolution branch.

The fourth jade slip… was for the Sovereign Realm evolution branch.

…

The one hundred and twenty-third jade slip… was for the Chaos Realm evolution branch.

…

The two hundred and thirty-third jade slip… was for the Sovereign Realm evolution branch.

…..

The three hundred and twelfth jade slip… was for the Sovereign Realm evolution branch.

…..

The three hundred and twenty-sixth jade slip… was for the Chaos Realm evolution branch.

…..

After observing over three hundred evolution paths, and examining the potential and outcomes of each path across countless future timelines,

even the Eye of Myriad Laws felt a tinge of exhaustion.

After all, it wasn’t truly a thirteenth-level time entity, merely possessing the rudimentary capabilities of one.

However.

Compared to its mental fatigue, the three hundred-plus evolution branches present were causing a storm in its heart.

Forget Lin Yuan merely being at the Path Splitting Realm—even for a Chaos Realm cultivator, the number of evolution routes they could develop was typically capped at a few dozen.

But Lin Yuan, hundreds?

And he was still just at the Path Splitting Realm yet had already developed hundreds of evolution branches?

What the Eye of Myriad Laws found most difficult to accept was that among these hundreds of evolution branches, at least their starting potential was at the Sovereign Realm, with a significant portion reaching the upper limit of the Chaos Realm.

For a mere Path Splitting Realm evolutionary main path, to not only develop hundreds of evolution branches but also achieve such extraordinary potential for each branch?

The Eye of Myriad Laws was momentarily stunned. Since its inception, it had observed countless evolution paths. Great Saints? Peerless Great Saints? Even those with the potential to cross into the thirteenth level’s Sky-Piercing Dao.

It had encountered them all.

But for Lin Yuan’s evolutionary main path, to accommodate such a terrifying quantity of evolution branches at the Path Splitting Realm, was simply unheard of.

“You…”

A faint red glimmer appeared deep within the pupils of the Eye of Myriad Laws.

It wanted to ask: Were these evolutionary paths recorded within the jade slips truly developed from a single main evolutionary path?

But with a shift of thought, it suppressed this doubt. With its ability, it was clear that the over three hundred evolutionary paths recorded within the jade slips, though diverse, ultimately stemmed from the same main evolutionary path.

The Eye of Myriad Laws was certain of this point.

It could discern that the Life and Death Martial Dao originated from a specific evolutionary main path, so naturally, it could see that these three hundred-plus evolution paths also originated from the same main path.

“What is the name of the main path from which these evolution branches originate?”

After a long silence, the Eye of Myriad Laws asked with some difficulty.

“The evolutionary main path?”

Lin Yuan felt a hint of confusion but still responded, “Martial Tao.”

“Martial Tao, Martial Tao!”

The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded, its gaze deep and unreadable, lost in thought.

“Then these evolution branches…”

Lin Yuan continued where the question had left off.

“I can help you disseminate them.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws replied.

“Actually, I have additional branches, but they remain in development and are still incomplete…” Lin Yuan thought for a moment and continued speaking.

Even while only staying at the Path Splitting Realm, the Martial Arts Evolution Road could produce over a thousand evolution branches. At the Sovereign Realm and Chaos Realm, this number would explode even further.

“Additional branches…”

The scalp of the Eye of Myriad Laws tingled as it listened.

What kind of Sky-Piercing Dao was this Martial Tao, to be capable of developing such a staggering number of evolutionary branches?

“Don’t worry. As long as they’re branches stemming from your evolutionary main path, I can help you disseminate them.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws collected itself and assured him.

“That would be ideal.”

A satisfied smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

If the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion could unconditionally help him disseminate all these evolution branches, then assisting them with one task over the course of ten Cosmic Eras,

was actually a fair deal.

It would be a standard trade.

“Then I’ll imprint a wisp of my soul essence into it now.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the golden scroll beside him, the mysterious aura emanating from the characters written upon it.

“Wait.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws also turned its gaze toward the golden scroll.

In an instant, the golden scroll began to disintegrate.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan turned toward the Eye of Myriad Laws, his heart sinking.

Could it be that the other party, upon realizing the sheer number of evolution branches he possessed, found disseminating them too burdensome to make the exchange worthwhile, and intended to revoke the deal or renegotiate new terms?

“I feel the terms we discussed earlier are somewhat unfair.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws fixed its gaze on Lin Yuan and, after a moment, spoke slowly.

“So you plan to redefine the terms?”

Lin Yuan asked, feeling a bit resigned.

He regretted not splitting the evolution branches he had presented initially.

However, when it came to the matters of post-Chaos Realm perfection, it was better to make sure and ensure clarity.

“So, what do you intend to do?”

Lin Yuan was already prepared for the Eye of Myriad Laws to make excessively greedy demands.

As long as the demands weren’t too over-the-top, he could still agree. After all, to disseminate such an extensive number of evolutionary paths on his own would be energy-draining and uncertain. Who knew whether he could even propagate them widely?

The development of evolutionary paths and their dissemination were entirely separate endeavors.

Without sufficient influence and authority, even the most widespread evolution paths could encounter insurmountable obstacles in some regions.

Not only did Lin Yuan require his evolution paths to be disseminated to anchor his path-mark beacons more firmly,

but even Chaos Venerables and Great Saints of Chaos would do the same.

“Speak your terms.”

Lin Yuan awaited the Eye of Myriad Laws’ demands.

“I’ll do my best to help you disseminate all the evolution branches.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws stated.

“Alright.” Lin Yuan nodded.

Waiting for the Eye of Myriad Laws to elaborate further.

But after waiting a while, he realized the other party had nothing more to add.
